title: Brand mark · International mark artwork versions
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose artwork in relation to the surface and production process. Symbol and lettering both need adequate contrast.
strategic_value: The international mark can retain recognition in full color, a single ink and reversed use.
demonstration: Six specimens compare gray or black lettering with a red symbol, single-color marks in black, red or gray, and a white mark on red.
practical_value: Choose two-color art on white, a suitable single-color master on a light field or the white version on a dark field. Use the supplied master for the publishing tool.

content_islands.name: Color guidance
content_islands.spec: Stack the two-color, single-color and white treatments at left.

content_islands.name: Artwork matrix
content_islands.spec: Place six captioned examples in two columns. Reserve the solid red field for the white version.

content_islands.name: File notes
content_islands.spec: Explain office PNG and scalable EPS uses in the small right column.
